content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script that fixes a 250-by-50 coordinate grid at 2 m spacing (L3-L9), loads instantaneous surface elevation, breaking-source-x and friction-source-x arrays for output index 21 (L12-L17), renders three x-direction panels and writes break_frc_inst.jpg (L19-L50), then switches the formatted index to 4, loads averaged FRCX and BrkDissX arrays (L52-L58), renders a second three-panel comparison and writes break_frc_avg.jpg (L62-L94).
entities: fdir: data-directory string assigned at L1
n, m: y- and x-grid counts assigned at L3-L4
dx, dy: coordinate increments assigned at L5-L6
x, y: coordinate vectors derived at L8-L9
num: output selector assigned at L12 and reassigned at L53
fnum: five-digit selector string assigned at L13 and reassigned at L54
eta, bx, fx: arrays loaded at L15-L17
FRCX, BrkDX: arrays loaded at L57-L58
cbar: colorbar handle assigned independently at L28, L37, L46, L71, L80, and L89

equations.ref: averaged output index formatting after num is reassigned

calls: subplot at L23, L32, L41, L66, L75, and L84
pcolor and shading at L24, L33, L42, L67, L76, and L85
axis at L25, L34, L43, L68, L77, and L86
xlabel at L26, L35, L44, L69, L78, and L87
colorbar at L28, L37, L46, L71, L80, and L89
get and set at L29, L38, L47, L72, L81, and L90
title at L30, L39, L48, L73, L82, and L91
unresolved: Cross-line data-index inconsistency: eta is loaded only while num=21/fnum=00021 at L12-L15; the averaged block changes num to 4 and fnum to 00004 at L53-L54 but reloads only FRCX and BrkDX at L57-L58, then reuses the stale index-21 eta at L67 in the figure labeled as averaged at L52 and written at L94. Thus figure 2 combines fields from different output indices.

Interface assumption without validation: x and y have lengths m=250 and n=50 from L3-L9, but none of the five load sites at L15-L17 and L57-L58 checks that the loaded matrices are 50-by-250 before pcolor calls at L24, L33, L42, L67, L76, and L85.
The hard-coded absolute fdir at L1 makes every load at L15-L17 and L57-L58 depend on one user-local directory; the file contains no override or existence check.
